verdict.rationale: Pipedream documents a CLI for building and deploying custom components. `pd deploy` deploys an event source from local or remote code, and `pd dev` links a local file to the deployed component and live-updates it. This is backed by source-available triggers and actions, a contribution path via GitHub PR, and TypeScript, Python and Java SDKs plus a REST API for the Connect service. missing for 10: in-pack documentation of the component authoring format (props/actions API) for private apps, and independent hands-on corroboration of building a custom connector.

support.subject: As a developer, I can build a custom connector or private integration with a documented developer platform, SDK, or CLI

citations.quote: Deploy an event source from local or remote code.
`pd dev` will link your local file with the deployed component and watch your local file for changes.
Source-available triggers and actions for thousands of integrated apps
You can also create a PR to contribute new components via GitHub.
Pipedream provides TypeScript, Python, and Java SDKs along with a REST API to interact with the Connect service.
